story.iWant: to implement JWT strategies and Passport guards
story.soThat: user identities can be securely authenticated via a standard Bearer token strategy
story.tasks: - Install `@nestjs/jwt` and `@nestjs/passport` libraries - Define `JwtStrategy` inside `auth.strategy.ts` - Implement `AuthService` methods for `login()` (minting payload) and `validateUser()` - Ensure token expires in `1h` (or as configured in env)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Injects the localized `.env` secret securely utilizing NestJS modules.
Properly mints a signed JWT based on User ID payload.
